## Notes
Parent story #299 covers epic #136 as a whole. The epic body
itself is audited there, not here.

Findings: `infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.tunnel.yml` and `infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/local/cloudflare-tunnel.yaml` (#143) are correct in isolation but unreferenced by `kustomization.yaml`, any script, or documentation — `start-tunnel.sh` (#144) bypasses both with its own `docker run --network host` call. Rescoped #142's AC2 and #145's criteria accordingly. #145's own criteria described `DeployControl.jsx`, deleted under ADR-015; rewritten to name what replaced it (`apiUrl.js`'s tunnel-fallback tier and static override). Wrote 5 new tests with no prior proof: `infrastructure/scripts/test_tunnel_manifests.py` (manifest content, `docker compose config` merge) and `infrastructure/scripts/test_tunnel_scripts.py` (start/stop script behavior against a faked `docker` on PATH, since no sandbox here has a Docker daemon or Cloudflare network egress). #144's live-tunnel criterion stays manual for the same reason.
